items.detail: Beyond Our Senses: Bank Swallows follows thousands of swallows as they return to the Lake Michigan bluffs each spring to nest, raise young, and survive using extraordinary perceptions that allow them to capture up to 3,500 insects per day among other incredible feats. Following the screening, filmmaker David Busse shares the behind-the-scenes story of his years-long, often obsessive pursuit of the film from daily check-ins on the colony to collaborations with a PhD researcher, conservationists, and filmmakers spanning from his home in Wisconsin to Ireland and beyond, all while becoming a father for the first time. A 4x Emmy Award-winning filmmaker based in South Milwaukee, Busse calls Beyond Our Senses his most ambitious project yet and is now touring it through festivals and community screenings across the Great Lakes region.
items.title: Beyond Our Senses: Bank Swallows
